## Summary

Ferrous Gate Engineering Ltd (policy CC-1703): theft of a laptop and an external drive from a locked storage unit at a university library. Covered under clause 4.2; reserve 4,732 dollars. The file does not give the date of the theft, and 7.5 turns on it (see Coverage analysis).

## Facts

Ferrous Gate Engineering Ltd reported the loss on 26 September 2026 [notice of loss]. The loss occurred at a university library [notice of loss]. The items are a laptop and an external drive [invoice 1], [invoice 2]. The theft was reported to the police on 28 September 2026, reference CR/2026/4247 [police report]. The items were in a locked container at the time [police report]. The date of the theft itself is not stated in the file [notice of loss], [police report].

## Coverage analysis

The loss falls under clause 4.2 of the policy, which covers loss of or damage to business contents at any other premises while in the insured's custody, caused by theft [policy]. The file does not say in terms who held the storage unit's key, so custody rests on the insured having reported the items as stored there [notice of loss], [police report].

Exclusion 7.1 does not apply: the items were in a locked container at the time [police report], [policy].

Exclusion 7.5 requires theft to be reported to the police within seven days. The police report is dated 28 September 2026 [police report], and the loss was reported to us on 26 September 2026 [notice of loss]. The theft was therefore on or before 26 September, but the file does not give its date. The seven-day condition is met if the theft was on or after 21 September 2026. The file does not show this directly, so the theft date should be confirmed with the insured and the exclusion treated as not applying on that basis [policy].

## Decision

Covered under clause 4.2. The claim is accepted, subject to confirming the theft date for exclusion 7.5.

## Reserve

The reserve is 4,732 dollars, the sum of the two invoices (2,603 dollars and 2,129 dollars) [invoice 1], [invoice 2]. The policy schedule is not in the file, so no excess is shown, and under clause 9.1 none applies where the schedule shows none [policy]. If the schedule is later found to apply the 250 dollar excess mentioned in clause 9.1, the reserve would be 4,482 dollars [policy].
